title: Bike-share "no dock to return to": edge reporting and an off-peak dispatch algorithm (proof of concept)
description: When a bike-share station is full, bikes end up outside the docks and official station data cannot see them. This proof of concept replays public data to estimate how a few off-peak trucks could pre-position bikes along forward routes inside 2 km circles, and how a Bluetooth temporary return could make the unseen bikes visible. Algorithmic replay, not operating results; no field deployment.
